summary: The Illinois Department of Transportation accepted all conditions requested by the school district, including replacement of sidewalks, provision for replacement of shrubbery or compensation, and replacement of the pedestrian underpass with an overpass.
text: The conditions were accepted by the Illinois Department of Transportation and include the replacement of all sidewalks, provision for the replacement of shrubbery either by actual plantings or by compensation with right-of-way damages, at the school district option, and the replacement of the pedestrian underpass with an overpass.

closing_anchor: and the replacement of the pedestrian underpass with an overpass.
